Answer with status, value, quotes and section.

answer.value: SFT corpus comprises four sources: publicly available datasets under permissive licenses, internally generated synthetic data targeting reasoning, tool calling, and chain-of-thought, agentic traces collected across diverse tasks, and a curated selection of human-authored data. Pre-training data details are deferred to the Granite 4.1 Technical Blog.
quotes: For all the three, 3B, 8B and 30B models, the training corpus comprises four sources: (1) publicly available datasets under permissive licenses, (2) internally generated synthetic data targeting reasoning, tool calling, and chain-of-thought capabilities, (3) agentic traces collected across a diverse range of tasks, and (4) a curated selection of human-authored data.
For full pre-training details (data composition, training recipe, and infrastructure), refer to our [Granite 4.1 Technical Blog](https://huggingface.co/blog/ibm-granite/granite-4-1).
